conditionsToggle.description: Collapsible heading, shown without a date range.

weekdaysShort.description: Comma separated weekday abbreviations, starting with Sunday. Exactly 7 items.

monthsShort.description: Comma separated month names, starting with January. Exactly 12 items.

dateHeader.description: Compact date in the navigation. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

dateShort.description: Date used in copied text. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

dateFull.description: Full date on the result card. $1 month, $2 day, $3 weekday, $4 month name, $5 year.

rangeFormat.description: Range separator used for both time ranges (10:00-11:00) and date ranges (7/24-7/31). $1 = start, $2 = end.

slotCount.description: Free slot count line. %%VALUE%% is replaced with slotCountValue, rendered in bold.

slotCountValue.description: Bold part of the free slot count. $1 = number of slots.

noAvailability.description: Shown when a day has no free slot.

copied.description: Shown after a slot is copied.

copiedAll.description: Shown after every slot is copied.
